name.title: Dataset name
name.description: Stem of the Auspice JSON written to auspice/<name>.json. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

title.title: Title
title.description: Shown at the top of the tree in Auspice.

reference_preset.title: Reference
reference_preset.description: A pathogen whose Nextstrain reference GenBank is used. Leave blank to use a GenBank file instead.

reference.title: Reference GenBank
reference.description: Used when no preset is chosen. When both are blank, the one GenBank file in the input dataset is used.

sequences.title: Sequences
sequences.description: FASTA of sequences. When blank, the one FASTA in the input dataset is used.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: TSV or CSV with one row per sequence. When blank, the one TSV/CSV in the input dataset is used.

metadata_id_columns.title: Strain column
metadata_id_columns.description: Metadata column holding the sequence names. Comma-separate several to try in order.

exclude.title: Exclude list
exclude.description: Optional text file of strain names to drop, one per line.

group_by.title: Subsample: group by
group_by.description: Comma-separated metadata columns to group by when subsampling, e.g. country,year,month.

sequences_per_group.title: Subsample: sequences per group
sequences_per_group.description: Keep at most this many sequences per group.

subsample_max_sequences.title: Subsample: maximum sequences
subsample_max_sequences.description: Keep at most this many sequences in total, spread evenly across groups.

min_length.title: Minimum length
min_length.description: Drop sequences with fewer valid nucleotides than this.

min_date.title: Earliest date
min_date.description: Drop sequences dated before this (YYYY-MM-DD or decimal year).

max_date.title: Latest date
max_date.description: Drop sequences dated after this (YYYY-MM-DD or decimal year).

timetree.title: Time-resolved tree
timetree.description: Infer a timetree from the metadata's date column. Turn off for undated data; tip frequencies are only made with a timetree.

clock_rate.title: Clock rate
clock_rate.description: Fixed substitution rate in substitutions per site per year. Estimated from the data when blank.

clock_std_dev.title: Clock rate standard deviation
clock_std_dev.description: Uncertainty of a fixed clock rate.

root.title: Root
root.description: best, least-squares, min_dev or oldest, or one or two strain names (comma-separated) to root on. augur's default (best) when blank.

coalescent.title: Coalescent model
coalescent.description: Coalescent prior for the timetree: opt, const, skyline, or a number (Tc). None when blank.

clock_filter_iqd.title: Clock filter (IQD)
clock_filter_iqd.description: Drop tips whose root-to-tip distance is more than this many interquartile ranges from the clock. Blank or 0 turns it off.

traits.title: Traits to reconstruct
traits.description: Comma-separated metadata columns whose ancestral states are inferred, e.g. country,region.

color_by.title: Color by
color_by.description: Comma-separated metadata columns offered as colorings in Auspice.

geo_resolutions.title: Geographic resolutions
geo_resolutions.description: Comma-separated metadata columns to place on the map, e.g. region,country. Need coordinates from augur's defaults or a lat-longs file.

auspice_config.title: Auspice config
auspice_config.description: Optional auspice_config.json with colorings, filters and display defaults.

lat_longs.title: Lat-longs
lat_longs.description: Optional TSV of coordinates: resolution, name, latitude, longitude.
